script: Isso acabou de acontecer na ciência e tecnologia: Where was Nvidia’s security team?. De acordo com relatórios publicados pela TechCrunch, os novos dados confirmam: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday conversations, which most corporate security teams are poorly equipped to catch. Isso muda completamente o cenário porque abre portas para aplicações que antes pareciam distantes. Acompanhe o canal para as próximas atualizações desta história.
